findings: In `components[1].sound[1]`, the entry compares 巴 bā with 吧 ba only in modern Mandarin, but the modern dictionary evidence also distinguishes the ordinary particle reading ba (neutral tone) from the separate bar reading bā. The article treats the phonetic role as applying to 吧 without identifying which reading it explains. Scope this comparison and phonetic explanation to the particle reading, and clarify that the available evidence does not establish the sound basis for the separate bar use. Update the corresponding learner card or displayed sound explanation so it does not imply the comparison explains every use of 吧. Cite current evidence for the particle reading and the distinct bar use, such as X-ec189aed5ee43a0268ad and X-df98e2b39c89a565bffe.
